Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to suspend 1 of my opponent's Digimon or Tamers even when this Digimon was originally unsuspended?

Effect: [When Digivolving] By suspending 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers, this Digimon unsuspends.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent’s Digimon or Tamers suspend, suspend 1 of your opponent’s Digimon or Tamers.
